text:
Plan 24 modules, all named below. Abbrev: w=workers, b=batch, t=timeout, qd=queue_depth.

Fixed: metrics w32 t55; reports w14 b350; scheduler w14 b400; notify b750; upload b700; catalog ttl390; session ttl330; auth ttl240; gateway ttl180; ingest w16; quota w20; archive qd450; search b400.

Limits: session qd≤20; quota qd≤30; notify w≥30; media t≥120; inventory retry≤3; auth b≤100; tenant retry≥8; shipping b≥900.

Owners: gamma—audit, quota, ingest; delta—billing, search, sync; alpha—shipping; beta—inventory.

Same worker: reports+billing; search+archive; metrics+session; gateway+inventory. Different: metrics/quota; pricing/shipping; profile/billing; profile/search.

Files: worker.py→quota; adapters.py→tenant; client.py→metrics; core.py, serial.py→profile; stubs.py→audit; models.py→notify; jobs.py→inventory.

Deps: quota→archive; gateway→ingest; cache→search; tenant→session; archive→scheduler; catalog→audit.

Forbidden (direct/transitive): archive→media; reports→scheduler; pricing→reports; gateway→indexer.

Order: inventory before reports; media before cache; shipping and session before indexer.

Everything else is your call.
